_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Expo package: kiosk link control, truthful email verification state, station enrolment, the combined movement goal, a phone-versus-kiosk answer before any account, and a queue that calls a participant by the name they chose. The follow-along player is in this commit but is deliberately NOT routed on staging.
_expectedPriorFunctionsNote: 31 before, 39 after. The prior count is unchanged from the last approval and is not a guess: run 35420931701 read the live project and refused with 'the staging baseline has 31 WSF functions'. This candidate adds EIGHT — wsfCreateCombinedGoal, wsfCombinedGoalPulse, wsfJoinQueue, wsfLeaveQueue, wsfMyQueueEntry, wsfQueueState, wsfCallNext, wsfFinishServing — so verify-deployment.mjs now requires 39 and names each of the eight as absent-if-absent. EXPECT THE FIRST RUN OF THIS CANDIDATE TO FAIL: eight brand-new services means eight invoker-policy sets, and this project's deploy service account cannot perform them (see run 35420410645, which created the seven station services and then aborted on exactly that). The services persist, so a SECOND run updates rather than creates and is expected to complete. That is a description of what this project does, not an endorsement: functions created that way are NOT callable, and a green second run must never be reported as a working capability. The seven station services are still invoker_iam_check_enabled per run 35421156377's own receipt, and the hosted smoke now probes the four public ones so the gap is visible rather than assumed. The fix is an IAM grant on this project and it is the owner's. wsfGoalPulse keeps its nine-field contract.
